title: Consonant Blends — Letters Working Together
memory_verse: "A cord of three strands is not quickly broken." — Ecclesiastes 4:12 (NIV)
objective: Students will recognize and read words with consonant blends at the beginning and end of words.
content: Just like friends work together, some letters work together too! When two consonants blend their sounds, we call it a consonant blend.
Beginning blends: 'bl' in 'bless,' 'cr' in 'cross,' 'gr' in 'grace,' 'pr' in 'pray,' 'st' in 'star,' 'tr' in 'trust.'
Ending blends: 'nd' in 'kind,' 'nk' in 'think,' 'st' in 'fast,' 'mp' in 'lamp.' Say each sound together quickly to make the blend!
activity: Circle the blends in these words: frog, stop, plan, lamp, gift, bless, cross, trust. Then draw pictures for four of the words and label them.
discussion: Can you find a blend in the word 'cross'?
How is working together like consonant blends?
